decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan, undated, received 11/03/13; "Existing" Plan, undated, received 11/03/13; and "Proposed" Plan, undated, received 11/03/13) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external door hereby permitted shall match the existing front doors of dwellings in Elizabeth Gardens.

Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the front fencing hereby permitted shall match the existing front fences of dwellings in Elizabeth Gardens in style, height, colour and materials.
description: Installation of new porch door and erection of fencing at the side of the driveway
